text:
Elena Martinez: Heads up — Legal pushed the final partner agreement for the Snowflake + Redwood connector. Key new bits: 99.9% SLA for Dedicated, telemetry sharing clause, and a 90-day marketplace exclusivity window for our listing. Need ops + partnerships alignment today.
Sam Chen: Copy. Can we get a quick summary of the exact telemetry fields they're requesting? is it just success/failure counts or also per-request latency + payload hashes?
Elena Martinez: They called out: request_id, timestamp, model_variant, success_flag, latency_ms, and a per-request sha256 of the prompt (no raw prompt content). Legal flagged that as privacy-safe but wants encryption in transit + at rest.
Priya Nair: Ok that's acceptable. For telemetry export we can send aggregated metrics to a partner S3 bucket or push via their ingestion API. Which do they prefer?
Jorge Alvarez: They prefer S3 bucket with fine-grained IAM. We'll need a short runbook for when a partner requests a retention export. Also need to confirm region (EU vs US) for customers in EU.
Claire Park: Related: co-marketing commit is contingent on listing date. They want a joint announcement within 2 weeks of GA. We should not promise GA until dedicated capacity tests finish.
Elena Martinez: Agreed. Proposed timeline: legal sign-off EOD today, infra staging validation by Wed, performance soak (48h) Thu-Fri, GA next Tue. That lines up with 9/19 announcement window if all green.
Sam Chen: Two red flags: (1) SLA at 99.9% — our Dedicated cluster SLOs can meet that but only with auto-scale + reserve. Need cost/commitment confirmation. (2) exclusivity window — 90 days on marketplace listing is ok but legal says revenue share terms kick in if they drive > $X in ARR. Need to quantify.
Priya Nair: For the SLA we can add an ops surcharge line item in the partner pricing table. I'll draft numbers today. For exclusivity revenue trigger, who's owning the negotiation? @Elena Martinez or legal-bot?
legal-bot: @Priya Nair Please loop in Legal (legal-ops@redwood.com) for revenue-trigger thresholds. Standard clause suggests $100k ARR threshold but negotiable.
Jorge Alvarez: Action items: (1) Infra: confirm autoscale config + cost delta — Sam (due EOD). (2) Partnerships: draft partner runbook and co-marketing brief — Priya (due tomorrow noon). (3) Legal: finalize revenue trigger language — Legal (Elena to confirm). (4) Privacy/Compliance: region + KMS flow for telemetry — Jorge (due Wed).
Claire Park: I'll draft the joint announcement outline but will mark it tentative until we hit GA. Add a short FAQ for customers about telemetry and privacy.
Sam Chen: Quick implementation note for infra: we should hash prompts using existing sha256 helper and store only hash in telemetry table. Pseudocode:
```
from hashlib import sha256
h = sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()
telemetry.record(request_id, model, latency_ms, success, prompt_hash=h)
```
Elena Martinez: Perfect — that satisfies legal's no-raw-prompt requirement. Also confirm: partner requires a marketplace listing tile with logo, 2 screenshots, and an integration doc. Priya can coordinate assets.
Priya Nair: I'll ping design for screenshots and marketing for the one-pager. Also will create a lightweight integration doc template for Snowflake/Databricks/Vector DB connectors.
Jorge Alvarez: For the region question — we'll default to the partner-specified S3 region but will not replicate telemetry out of region unless customer opts in. Need KMS key policy template for partner access.
Elena Martinez: Final ask: can we have a short tabletop run on Friday (30 min) to validate incident flow for a partner outage and SLA crediting? Calendar invite incoming.
Claire Park: I'll join and bring the announcement checklist. :+1:
Sam Chen: Will prepare the autoscale numbers and expected cost delta.
Priya Nair: Drafting runbook now, will share a link here when ready.
legal-bot: Document updated: partner_agreement_v3.pdf uploaded to /legal/partners/Snowflake_redwood_v3. @Elena Martinez please review.
Elena Martinez: Thanks everyone — if we hit sign-off today I’ll kick the staging validation this afternoon. Keep updates in this thread. :rocket:
